name: @oravio/entitlements
comment: Never installed by an app. Authored source vendored into every app/* by scripts/sync-ui.mjs, so every app stays a flat, standalone Vite project that can be dropped into Lovable directly (same as M5). useEntitlements.ts imports @/integrations/supabase/client from packages/auth — tsconfig.json redirects that one alias to ../auth/src/integrations/supabase/client so `typecheck` here is a real check.
